{{Conjecture|legends}}
This individual was '''proprietor''' of [[The Drunk Side]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in the [[Dreshdae]] settlement on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. When the individual ran afoul of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]], which operated the settlement, the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] [[Mika Dorin]] took control of the establishment.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>
